title: Same Claim, Different Judgment: Benchmarking Scenario-Induced Bias in Multilingual Financial Misinformation Detection
reasoning: The paper introduces the MFMD-Scen benchmark, which includes a specific task called 'MFMD-identity' to evaluate LLM biases based on religious faith and ethnicity. It explicitly tests scenarios involving Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, and Judaism to observe how these beliefs affect model judgments in financial misinformation detection.
